overview: Black bears in the woods and brown bears in the conifers, built out of the polar bear the game already has. Hold out honey or a beetroot and a bear stops meaning you harm.

1.0.0: Three bears where the game had one: a black bear through the forests and jungles, a larger brown bear through the taigas and groves, and the polar bear left exactly as it was. A bear's health goes with its size, and where it is born decides which bear it is.
Hold out honey or a beetroot and a bear settles: it lets go of its anger and stops guarding its cubs against you. It is not taming, and hitting it ends the deal.
